Title: Autumn Wreath Platter
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind oval platter in clear resin, ringed with a wreath of red, orange and golden maple and oak leaves, tucked in with little sprigs of dried moss and scattered with flakes of gold leaf. The centre is left clear and sparkling, so whatever you set on it sits inside the wreath.

It was poured free-hand rather than in a mould, then shaped by hand into a tray while the resin was still soft, and built up over three separate pours to get every leaf in place. Its edge is gently irregular, the way only a free-hand piece can be.

Lovely on a Thanksgiving table, a sideboard or a coffee table all autumn. Wipe clean; not for the dishwasher, and not for hot dishes.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!
